title: Small hole, fluid gets in between outer and inner glass
text:
Small hole, fluid gets in between outer and inner glass. These glasses have a small hole in the bottom, which has a bit of glue in it when you receive the glasses.

*Inevitably* water gets between the outer and inner glass. And it is very difficult to nearly impossible to get out.

So they are just not useable. If the hole is necessary to prevent a pressure differential that will break the glass, then the design is flawed.

Junk
